mapper.update: UPDATE TB_REVIEW SET STATUS = 'DELETED', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} /* 본인 확인 보안 로직 */

UPDATE TB_LAWYER SET AVG_RATING = ( SELECT NVL(ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1), 0) FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ), REVIEW_CNT = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_REVIEW WHERE LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ) WHERE LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.REVIEW_ID, r.MEMBER_ID, /* 프론트엔드에서 본인 글인지 확인하기 위해 추가 */ r.RATING, r.CONTENT, r.CREATED_AT, SUBSTR(m.NAME, 1, 1) || '*' || SUBSTR(m.NAME, LENGTH(m.NAME), 1) as REVIEWER_NAME FROM TB_REVIEW r JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.LAWYER_ID = #{lawyerId} AND r.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT c.CONSULT_ID, c.LAWYER_ID, m.NAME as LAWYER_NAME, l.OFFICE_NAME, c.CONSULT_DATE FROM TB_CONSULT c JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON c.LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON l.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE c.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND c.STATUS = 'DONE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_REVIEW r WHERE r.CONSULT_ID = c.CONSULT_ID AND r.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' /* 삭제된 리뷰는 다시 작성 가능하게 처리 */ ) ORDER BY c.CONSULT_DATE DESC
